name: QIDI PET-CF (PET-CF17) @BBL A1
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page (current TDS 'PET-CF17'): nozzle 270-300 C, bed 70-80 C (glue), speed up to 300 mm/s, density 1.34, drying 100 C 10 h, annealing 80-100 C 4-8 h (TDS: 120 C 10 h). QIDI blog: TDS chamber = room temperature, print enclosed with heater off, fan off (guide allows 0-50 %); earlier product page listed 280-320 C / 80 C / 40-200 mm/s / drying 100 C 4-8 h. Comparison guide: closed chamber required, HDT 155.3 C. Cardboard spool: use a spool adapter in QIDI BOX. Support: S-White.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/pet-cf-filament
